caption: The video captures a near-stationary upward view of an overcast sky, with soft gray cloud masses and brighter diffuse patches toward the left. A small dark tree-branch silhouette anchors the bottom-right corner, while a faint pale diagonal streak runs along the right edge, both appearing fixed, consistent with a largely stationary camera. Across the excerpt the cloud field undergoes only very slow, subtle deformation, with gentle shifts in brightness and form rather than large translation. The overall cloud structure stays recognizable from the first frame to the last, drifting almost imperceptibly against the fixed foreground. Near the middle a tiny dark winged silhouette flickers momentarily into the upper-left region before vanishing in the following frames. The pale streak and the branch hold the same positions throughout, consistent with little or no panning or zooming. The scene thus presents a quiet, ongoing cloud drift rather than a discrete completed action.
